seo.title: TKPK & TKBT Work-at-Height Training (Kemnaker) | RAC
seo.description: RAC training programmes certified by Kemnaker RI: TKPK Levels 1–3 for rope access and TKBT Levels 1–2 for high structures. Open and in-house courses.

hero.title: Training That Prepares You for the Job, Not Just the Exam
hero.body: Kemnaker-certified work-at-height training — from zero experience to supervisor, for rope access (TKPK) and high structures (TKBT).

sections.title: Choose a training programme
sections.intro: Every programme includes theory, practice at height, use of training equipment, and preparation for the Kemnaker competency test.

sections.title: Kemnaker certification grades for work at height
sections.intro: A summary of each grade’s role and main prerequisites. Final requirements follow current Kemnaker rules.
rows: Rope access technician working under supervision
Age 18+, medically fit, no experience needed
Rigs anchor systems, advanced rescue, supervises Level 1
Supervisor: work plans, rescue plans, team leadership
TKPK 1 & 2, senior secondary education, age 22+, experience (typically 1,000+ hours), first aid
Climbs and works on structures using fall arrest
Age 18+, medically fit, no experience needed
Works independently and supervises teams on high structures
TKBT 1 + experience of work at height
sections.note: TKPK = Tenaga Kerja pada Ketinggian (rope access). TKBT = Tenaga Kerja Bangunan Tinggi (climbing structures with fall arrest).

sections.title: Four steps to a Kemnaker certificate

items.title: 1. Consultation
items.text: Tell us about your work and experience; we help you choose the right programme and grade.

items.title: 2. Enrolment & documents
items.text: Send your details, a medical statement, and proof of experience (for Levels 2 and 3).

items.title: 3. Training
items.text: Theory and practice at height with instructor support until you are test-ready.

items.title: 4. Test & certificate
items.text: A competency test under Kemnaker rules; successful candidates receive a certificate and K3 licence.

sections.title: Need a dedicated course for your team?
sections.text: For a group from one company, training can run on dates you choose — at our training site or at yours.
